subtopics.label: Active Surveillance and Focal/Partial Gland Ablation for Localized Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on conservative management strategies for localized prostate cancer including active surveillance protocols, partial gland ablation, cryoablation, and focal therapy outcomes, with emphasis on patient selection, monitoring intensity, and oncologic versus functional trade-offs.

subtopics.label: Surgical Management and Functional Outcomes in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies examining radical prostatectomy techniques including robot-assisted, Retzius-sparing, and pelvic fascia-sparing approaches, with outcomes covering urinary continence, oncologic control, perioperative safety, and comparative effectiveness across surgical methods.

subtopics.label: PSMA-Targeted Imaging and Theranostics in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA)-based PET imaging, radioligand therapy (including 177Lu-PSMA-617 and novel PSMA ligands), and theranostic applications for staging, biochemical recurrence detection, and treatment of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

subtopics.label: MRI-Guided Prostate Biopsy and Imaging-Based Cancer Detection
subtopics.description: Studies on multiparametric MRI, PI-RADS classification, transperineal versus transrectal biopsy approaches, MRI-targeted biopsy techniques, and AI/radiomics methods for detecting clinically significant prostate cancer and reducing unnecessary procedures.

subtopics.label: Systemic Therapy for Advanced and Metastatic Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Clinical research on androgen receptor pathway inhibitors (enzalutamide, abiraterone, cabazitaxel), combination regimens, treatment sequencing, and survival outcomes in metastatic castration-sensitive and castration-resistant prostate cancer settings.

subtopics.label: Molecular Biology, Genomics, and Tumor Heterogeneity in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Investigations into the molecular underpinnings of prostate cancer including androgen receptor signaling variants (AR-V7, SPOP mutations), neuroendocrine differentiation, chromatin remodeling, clonal evolution, structural rearrangements, and multi-focal tumor heterogeneity.

subtopics.label: Lipid Metabolism and Metabolomics in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Preclinical and translational studies examining fatty acid synthesis (FASN), de novo lipogenesis, metabolomic profiling, and lipid pathway targeting as therapeutic vulnerabilities in prostate cancer including castration-resistant disease.

subtopics.label: Racial and Socioeconomic Disparities in Prostate Cancer Screening and Treatment
subtopics.description: Research documenting racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic disparities in PSA screening rates, MRI access, active surveillance utilization, surgical approach selection, and treatment outcomes in prostate cancer, including analyses of USPSTF guideline impacts.

subtopics.label: Systemic Therapy and Immunotherapy for Advanced Urothelial and Bladder Cancer
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and real-world studies evaluating immune checkpoint inhibitors (atezolizumab, pembrolizumab), antibody-drug conjugates (sacituzumab govitecan), FGFR inhibitors, and combination regimens for locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma.

subtopics.label: Surgical Management, Pathology, and Cytology of Bladder and Urothelial Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies on surgical approaches for bladder cancer (radical cystectomy, TURBT), urothelial carcinoma cytopathology and histopathology including The Paris System criteria, neoadjuvant chemotherapy outcomes, and sex/demographic disparities in treatment access.

subtopics.label: Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma: Molecular Features, Surgery, and Chemotherapy
subtopics.description: Research focused on upper tract urothelial carcinoma (UTUC) including molecular characterization, genomic landscape, neoadjuvant chemotherapy efficacy, surgical outcomes (nephroureterectomy), nomogram development, and clonal evolution of metastatic disease.

subtopics.label: Renal Cell Carcinoma Biology, Biomarkers, and Systemic Treatment
subtopics.description: Studies on clear cell and other renal cell carcinoma subtypes covering molecular biology (ATF4, NDUFA4L2, VHL pathway), liquid biopsy biomarkers, targeted therapy (pazopanib, cabozantinib), immunotherapy combinations, and surgical approaches including ablation.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy, ctDNA, and Genomic Profiling in Bladder and Urothelial Cancer
subtopics.description: Research on circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), cell-free DNA methylation, APOBEC mutagenesis, and genomic/transcriptomic profiling for monitoring disease progression, treatment response prediction, and understanding clonal evolution in bladder and urothelial cancers.

subtopics.label: Biomarkers, Genomic Risk Scores, and Molecular Diagnostics in Prostate Cancer
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating tissue-based genomic tests (Decipher), metabolomic and proteomic biomarkers, polygenic risk scores, tumor volume and PSA density as predictors of pathologic risk, recurrence, and treatment selection in localized and advanced prostate cancer.

subtopics.label: Comorbidity Management and Health Outcomes in Cancer Survivors
subtopics.description: Research examining how comorbid conditions such as diabetes and heart failure are managed before and after cancer diagnosis, including racial disparities in comorbidity care among cancer survivors.

subtopics.label: Patient Decision-Making Support, Health Literacy, and Cancer Beliefs
subtopics.description: Studies investigating health literacy, fatalistic cancer beliefs, and decision-making support interventions among diverse and minority cancer patient populations, and their effects on screening, quality of life, and mortality.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Tools in Oncology Decision Support
subtopics.description: Research on AI and machine learning applications for clinical decision support, therapeutic sequencing, and precision oncology, including biologically constrained predictive models and AI-generated patient information.

subtopics.label: Racial and Ethnic Disparities in Surgical Access and Minimally Invasive Procedures
subtopics.description: Systematic reviews and studies examining racial and ethnic disparities in access to robot-assisted surgery and minimally invasive surgical procedures for pelvic and urologic cancers.

subtopics.label: Immune-Related Adverse Events and Inflammatory Biomarkers in Urologic Cancer Immunotherapy
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing immune-related adverse events (irAEs) and inflammatory biomarkers such as NLR and SII as prognostic factors in patients with metastatic renal cell carcinoma and urothelial cancer treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.

subtopics.label: Long Non-Coding RNAs and Chromatin Regulation in Urologic Cancers
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular and cellular functions of long non-coding RNAs and high-order chromatin conformations in prostate and other cancers, including their roles in gene regulation and therapeutic resistance.

subtopics.label: Preclinical Biology and Novel Therapeutic Targets in Bladder Cancer
subtopics.description: Preclinical studies investigating molecular targets and novel agents in bladder cancer, including fascin inhibitors that reduce cell migration and adhesion, and circulating tumor cell phenotyping in solid cancers.

subtopics.label: Patient-Reported Outcomes, Quality of Life, and Survivorship After Prostate Cancer Treatment
subtopics.description: Qualitative and quantitative studies capturing the lived experience of prostate cancer survivors, including long-term treatment trade-offs, functional outcomes, and perspectives following contemporary localized prostate cancer treatment.
